about: The Workbench icons of the Freedroid drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own influence device, droid 001 (graphics/001.png). Each theme drawer inside graphics gets a copy of graphics.info, which Workbench places itself. drawer.info is the Freedroid drawer's own icon, installed as Freedroid.info beside it.
